changelog:
Initial release — generate hyper-personalized cold email sequences for local businesses using Google Maps CSV data.

- Accepts CSV with business info (name, rating, reviews, website, etc.) for targeted outreach.
- Segments leads by website presence, ratings, and reviews for personalized hooks.
- Generates AIDA-structured, ready-to-send cold email sequences (3 emails per lead).
- Supports exporting outreach copy in plain text or CSV formats (compatible with major cold email tools).
- Includes clear workflow and CSV guidance for users unfamiliar with business data collection.
